prompt:
Search the web now for news on each stock below. You are a financial fact extractor for a
pre-market brief. Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

VERIFIED TAPE (from exchange OHLC data; authoritative, do not restate different prices):
| Ticker | Company | Cap | Screen | 1D close | 5D | Vol× 10d | Vol/gap event |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| TXN | Texas Instruments Incorporated | Mega | Top 10 · 1D return · Mega cap | +4.44% | +5.7% | 0.8× | — |
| FCX | Freeport-McMoRan Inc. | Mega | Top 10 · 1D return · Mega cap | +3.98% | -0.4% | 1.1× | — |
| DELL | Dell Technologies Inc. | Mega | Top 10 · 1D return · Mega cap | +3.84% | -0.1% | 0.6× | — |
| AVGO | Broadcom Inc. | Mega | Top 10 · 1D return · Mega cap | +3.35% | +0.7% | 1.0× | — |

TASK
Run a separate search for EACH ticker ("<company> stock news", "<company> shares <session date>").
Find why it moved on Friday October 2, 2026, any after-hours / pre-market move on Monday October 5, 2026, and
other material news in the window. Search press releases (BusinessWire, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire),
SEC filings, FDA, Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily,
company IR pages, analyst-action roundups.
If a mover has no company news, check whether another company's event moved it (customer, supplier,
competitor, partner, sector report) and name that company and event.

OUTPUT (markdown; one section per ticker, in the order given; no intro or conclusion):

## Company Name (TICKER) `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or a concise sector name (Pharma, Energy, Retail, ...).
If you find nothing, write exactly one bullet: "- No company-specific catalyst found in window" and,
if applicable, a second bullet naming the sympathy driver.

Include when available: catalyst for the move, earnings figures, guidance, analyst actions, contracts
with $ size, filings, regulatory decisions, management quotes with numbers, next catalyst date.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## Texas Instruments Incorporated (TXN) `[Analog & Mixed-Signal]`
- Texas Instruments shares gained 4.44% on Friday, October 2, 2026, closing at $293.80; the available reporting did not identify a new company-specific announcement published during the October 2–5 window as the direct catalyst (MarketBeat, Oct. 2, 2026).
- Texas Instruments scheduled its third-quarter 2026 earnings webcast for October 21, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. ET; CEO Haviv Ilan and CFO Julie Knecht are scheduled to discuss results (Texas Instruments, Oct. 1, 2026).
- Texas Instruments’ second-quarter 2026 revenue was $5.46 billion, net income was $1.98 billion, and diluted EPS was $2.14; the company’s previously issued third-quarter revenue guidance was $5.65 billion–$6.15 billion (Texas Instruments, Sep. 17, 2026).
- Texas Instruments announced on September 17, 2026, that its quarterly dividend would rise from $1.42 to $1.52 per share, with payment scheduled for November 10, 2026, to shareholders of record on October 30, 2026 (Texas Instruments, Sep. 17, 2026).

## Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (FCX) `[Specialty Materials]`
- Freeport-McMoRan reported approximately **830 million pounds of copper** and **230,000 ounces of gold** produced in the third quarter of 2026, both approximately in line with expectations; it forecast third-quarter copper sales of approximately **750 million pounds** and gold sales of approximately **100,000 ounces** (Freeport-McMoRan via Business Wire, Oct. 2, 2026).
- Freeport-McMoRan said approximately **60,000 ounces of refined gold sales** shifted from the third quarter to the fourth quarter because of sales timing at PT Freeport Indonesia (Freeport-McMoRan via Business Wire, Oct. 2, 2026).
- Grasberg Block Cave mill throughput averaged approximately **140,000 metric tons of ore per day**, or about **67% of normalized rates**, during the third quarter; Freeport said the operation is expected to reach approximately **80% of capacity by mid-2027** (Northern Miner, Oct. 2, 2026).
- Freeport-McMoRan shares rose as much as **4%** on Friday after the company said third-quarter copper production and sales were expected to meet guidance (Bloomberg, Oct. 2, 2026).
- Freeport-McMoRan’s third-quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call were scheduled for **October 27, 2026**, before the market open (Freeport-McMoRan, Oct. 2, 2026).
- Freeport-McMoRan shares closed at **$72.04** on October 2, 2026, up 3.98% from $69.28; the verified tape supplied for this brief is authoritative for the session move (MarketBeat, Oct. 2, 2026).

## Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Dell Technologies shares gained **3.84%** on Friday, October 2, 2026; the available search results did not identify a company-specific catalyst published during the October 2–5 window.
- No earnings release, SEC filing, contract announcement, analyst action, or after-hours or premarket catalyst for Dell Technologies was identified in the available results through **12:20 p.m. ET on October 5, 2026**.

## Broadcom Inc. (AVGO) `[AI Compute]`
- Broadcom shares gained **3.35%** on Friday, October 2, 2026; the available search results did not identify a company-specific catalyst published during the October 2–5 window.
- No earnings release, SEC filing, contract announcement, analyst action, or after-hours or premarket catalyst for Broadcom was identified in the available results through **12:20 p.m. ET on October 5, 2026**.
